description: Facebook post comments with reactionCount, reactions.like when mixed, author.id (pfbid), and replyCount. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

feedbackId.description: Post feedback id from /v1/facebook/details (base64 feedback:POSTID). Prefer when you already have it — also accepts feedback_id.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 50, max 500). Flat 2 credits per call.

url.description: Facebook post or Reel URL. Omit when feedbackId is set. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform.

name: facebook_comments
title: Facebook Comments
